symptom: Node 22.16.0 synthetic JSON projection showed that symbol-keyed and non-enumerable own context properties, as well as inherited metadata, serialize identically to a context lacking those properties. The shadow builder canonicalizer previously skipped symbol and hidden own keys and accepted non-plain object prototypes, allowing distinct malformed source/context objects to share a digest. No external K evidence, real private paths, raw odds, secrets or production records were used.
lesson: Canonical JSON digests must bind the admitted own-property shape, not only enumerable string-keyed values. Symbol keys and hidden own data can disappear from JSON; inherited metadata and exotic objects can be projected as a different shape. This property-key/prototype alias is distinct from non-JSON scalar value omission.
guardrail: For research-only shadow source/context canonicalization, require plain/null object prototypes and own enumerable string-keyed data fields. Reject symbol keys and non-enumerable/accessor properties before hashing. Regression-test synthetic aliases and ordinary digest compatibility. Reuse the Forward Vault own-data property-shape guardrail. No K-source authenticity, scoring, merge or production authority follows.
